name: Couch Savings Hack
hook: Skip the bar, boot the console, and bank imaginary nightlife savings
tagline: A frugal gamer barricades their living room couch against nightclub invites while stacking imaginary $100 drink tabs saved into a glowing financial freedom fortress. Cashing out locks in the bank balance as our hero eats microwave pizza in peaceful victory. Crashing triggers a doorstep raid of bottle-service VIPs dragging you straight to a $400 cocktail lounge.
